title: Partially correct, partially wrong compound claim (hard case)
claim: Revenue grew 15% and headcount decreased by 10% this year, showing improved efficiency.
source: Revenue grew 15% this year. Headcount increased by 4% this year.
tests: This is the required 'challenging case.' A compound claim with one true and one false part is genuinely tricky — does atomic extraction correctly split this into two separate claims and verify each on its own, or does it average into a wrong overall 'mostly true' verdict?
